name: DigitalDownloadsSample
description: Creates a Digital Product type and an Ebooks listing at /ebooks whose buyers download files after paying, with two sample ebooks priced in US dollars, with covers and their PDF files, links that work 14 days for 3 downloads, and two coupons: WELCOME10 (10% off, once per customer) and EBOOKS5 ($5 off orders of $15 or more).
author: CrestApps

HtmlBodyPart.Html: A 60-page field guide to trail navigation, packing and safety, as a PDF you download right after paying.
Forty one-pot recipes for the trail and the campsite, as an ebook.
